changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6625-retire-fieldmeta-decimals.md`

- names `GridField.tsx` → `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `buildFieldMeta` computed `decimals: overrides.decimals ?? meta?.decimals ?? meta?.scale` on **every** call and the value **reached nothing**. Re-measured on this branch's base (`efdc6c62`): **zero `.decimals` member reads** across `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/core` and `plugin-dashboard` itself — the only non-comment occurrence was the write being removed here. The **positive control in the same query shape** fires: `.scale` member reads hit `NumberField.tsx`, `GridField.tsx` and `fields/src/index.tsx`. So the zero is a finding, not a broken query. The `overrides.decimals ??` head of that chain had already lost its only feeder when objectui#6425's ruling removed the authored read from `ObjectDataTable.enrich()`; `RecordDetailDrawer`, the only other `buildFieldMeta` caller, passes no overrides at all. Both halves retire together, so the key leaves in one move.

### `.changeset/6661-app-launcher-nav-menu-renderers.md`

- names `en.ts` → `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` — edited by this change

  > Three new strings — the launcher's and the menu's accessible names, and the menu's empty state — are declared under `console.nav` in `en.ts` and its nine sibling packs. An inline `defaultValue` alone is not a fix: it renders English at one call site and leaves the string untranslatable everywhere (objectui#3517).

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `a782fa732` (merge-base with origin/main): 18 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1780 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2386 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36650682202)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b7b0a579547df74f0600a2275219e5916b5a4d17`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#11145 (body; triage `5900707384`, claim `5901111454`, dev report `5901703533`), PR objectui#11159 (body, its 19-file list, the net diff against `main`), the head's check-runs read with `filter=latest`, and head-side reads of `en.ts` and the nine other packs, `formChrome.ts`, `LineItemsPanel.tsx`, `GridField.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `useSafeTranslation.ts`, `useFieldTranslation.ts`, `fallbackInterpolation.ts`, `provider.tsx`, `i18n.ts`, `ci.yml`, the `.changeset/` listing and `packages/i18n/CHANGELOG.md`.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept set.** Nothing moves: `LineItemsPanelSchema` is untouched, no export, prop or type changes in any of the three packages, and `PanelError` / `panelError` are module-private. Right.

**Public surface.** Two default en strings change: the open-row tooltip `Open full form` becomes `Open row` and the duplicate tooltip `Duplicate line` becomes `Duplicate row`. Both are stated in the changeset with the reason (the accessible name is the text kept per meaning). Every other en output is byte-identical, with and without a provider (byte check below). Right.

**The ten new keys against reuse-before-adding** — each searched in `en.ts` at the head for an existing key carrying the same meaning:
1. `form.lineItems.saveRecordFirst` — no existing key. Right.
2. `form.lineItems.notLoaded` — none. Right.
3. `form.lineItems.loadFailed` — nearest are `form.errorLoading` (`Error loading form`), `grid.errorLoading` (`Error loading grid`) and `organization.*.loadFailed`, each naming another subject; there is no generic key. Right.
4. `form.lineItems.saveFailed` — nearest are `form.saveError` (`Failed to save`) and `table.saveFailed` (`Save failed`); the literal names its subject and the claim holds en byte-equal outside the row actions, so reusing either would have been an unstated en change. Right.
5. `form.lineItems.noChildObject` — none (`MasterDetailForm`'s twin hint is a literal, not a key; ③ b). Right.
6. `fields.grid.optionalColumns` — none. Right.
7. `fields.grid.computed` — none. Right.
8. `fields.grid.openRow` — nearest are `grid.openRecord` (`Open record`, the data grid's stored-record action), `table.expandRow` (inline expansion) and `detail.openAsFullPage`; a line-items row is not necessarily a stored record, and `Open row` is the accessible name existing tests hold. Right.
9. `fields.grid.duplicateRow` — nearest is `detail.duplicate` (`Duplicate`, the record page's record action); the meaning here is row-scoped. Right.
10. `fields.grid.removeRow` — nearest are `form.removeItem` (`Remove item`), `lookup.remove` (`Remove {{label}}`) and `detail.deleteRow` (`Delete`, with a confirmation); `Remove row` is the accessible name four existing test files hold and the claim keeps it byte-equal. Right, and the closest call of the ten.

**Reused keys.** `common.loading` (`Loading…`), `table.columns` (`Columns`), `form.masterDetail.total` (`Total` — every pack spells the plain word, de `Gesamt`, ja `合計`, ru `Итого`, so the column-sum footer borrows nothing tax-shaped from the totals stack), `view.dragToReorder` (`Drag to reorder`), and `form.lineItems.title` for the untitled heading through a `formChrome.ts` row rather than a new key, as the triage directed. Right.

**Ten packs, byte-equal en.** Each of ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh and en adds exactly the ten keys (five under `form.lineItems`, five under `fields.grid`), and every `noChildObject` sentence carries `{{property}}`. Every GridField inline `defaultValue` (11 of 11, the three from objectui#11131 included), every `useLineItemsTranslation` row (11 of 11) and the new `formChrome.ts` row are byte-equal to the en pack value of their key, the U+2019 in `record’s` and the U+2026 in `Loading…` included. The head's Type Check run — the job that runs `check:i18n-keys` and `check:i18n-drift` (`ci.yml` lines 517 and 530) — is `success`. Right.

**Server message still wins; fallback at render time.** `panelError` keeps the old `||` truthiness (`message ? { message } : { op }`), and the banner shows `error.message` verbatim when one was sent; only the `op` arm calls `t`. Under a provider that `t` is react-i18next's bound `t` from `useObjectTranslation`, whose reader re-renders on `languageChanged`, so a language switch re-resolves the fallback sentence instead of keeping a stale one; the server's own words stay as sent, which is right for text that is not ours. `load`'s dependency list carries no `t`, so the stated reason for the state shape holds. Right.

**The `{{property}}` split.** The panel asks for the sentence with `property: '{{property}}'` and splits on it. Under a provider `escapeValue` is false and i18next's default `skipOnVariables` leaves the inserted literal alone; without one, `interpolateFallback`'s split/join does the same. The `code` element holding `childObject` sits between the halves, pinned in zh and in the no-provider file. Right.

**Row actions, one meaning one key.** Drag `view.dragToReorder`, open `fields.grid.openRow`, duplicate `fields.grid.duplicateRow`, each read by both `aria-label` and `title`; remove `fields.grid.removeRow` on its single `aria-label` (no tooltip before, none after). The en text per meaning is stated in the changeset. Existing pins moved: none — the diff touches no existing test file, `Open row` and `Remove row` are unchanged (held in `MasterDetailForm.busReread-10853.test.tsx` and in four files respectively), and no test names `Open full form` or `Duplicate line`; the eight test shards are the gate for that claim and are read below. Right.

**Pins against the direction.** zh renders of the three measured sites (`保存记录后才能添加明细行。`, `合计` in the `totalField` footer, `明细行` as the untitled heading): present. One row-action label per meaning in zh and en with `aria-label` equal to `title`: present. An en control (the en-provider case plus the two no-provider files): present. An authored title unchanged (`Order lines` CONTROL): present. Plus a server-message CONTROL. Right.

**de census.** None of the ten new de rows carries a „…“ span, so no census pin is owed. Right.

**Changeset claim re-read.** The two pending changesets the gate named still read true on this diff: no `scale` or `decimals` line in the GridField hunks, no `console` or `nav` line in any pack hunk. Right.

**Gates on the head.** All 43 latest check-runs on the head are completed, read at 2026-09-30T00:46Z: 40 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard N/4)`), none failed or cancelled. The families this diff derives are each `success`: Type Check (the job that runs `check:i18n-keys` and `check:i18n-drift`), Lint, Test shards 1 to 8 and the `Test` aggregate (the 22 new pins ran there, and no existing pin failed, which is the head-side evidence that none moved), Test (dist pins), Control Byte Scan, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Claim Re-read, Line Citation Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Build and E2E. Right.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `11145-line-items-chrome-remainder.md`: `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, each `patch`. What the diff publishes: no export, prop or type change in `fields` or `plugin-form`; two default tooltip strings changed (stated); ten pack keys added in `i18n`. objectui's own grading of added pack keys is patch: the family's four pending changesets (`10999-wizard-form-chrome-i18n`, `11039-form-chrome-i18n`, `11071-form-chrome-remainder`, `11131-line-items-chrome`) each grade `@object-ui/i18n` patch for the keys they add, and `packages/i18n/CHANGELOG.md` files key additions under Patch Changes in 17.4.0 (`Three new keys … land in all ten locale packs`), 17.3.0 (`All five new keys`, `Eight new keys`, `The 21 genuinely new keys`) and 17.0.0 (`The 18 new keys`). The one key addition under a Minor heading (17.5.0, `0082db8`) also threaded a new optional parameter onto an exported function, which is what earned the minor. Patch matches. The Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy (no major) and Changeset Fixed Group Check runs are `success`. Right.

Clause-②: no — right. No schema, prop, type or accepted set moves; the two tooltip texts are defaults, not a contract.

1. The single dispatched vitest run split into four locked runs after an exit-137 container restart — local-run mechanics; the head's test shards are the gate. Answered.
2. Whole-package counts cited at `d32cd3964` with a declared narrowing at `b7b0a5795`, whose only change narrows `panelError`'s parameter from `any` to `unknown` — the diff confirms that scope, and the shards run the whole at the head. Answered.

4. Remove row keeps `aria-label` only — the one key serves the one attribute it has; no behaviour was added. Answered.

Out-of-scope findings:
- (a) GridField's invalid-cell text `${c.label || c.name} is required` — real at the head (line 1342 as the cell's `title`; lines 1105 and 1125 as the `error` prop of the lookup and file cells), on lines no hunk touches, so pre-existing at the base; `validation.required` (`{{field}} is required`) exists at en line 201. Same grid, same English-under-zh symptom, but a validation message the card did not name among its sites, so not a breach of this card. Escalated to the seat: one class (a) remainder card (three call sites, one existing key).
- (b) `MasterDetailForm`'s three config hints — real at the head (`md-detail-no-child-object` line 744, `md-detail-schema-unavailable` line 765, `md-detail-no-relationship-field` line 788), untouched by the diff so pre-existing. The first is the twin of the panel hint this card translated, and all three sit in the form whose heading this card fixed: same family, not named by the card. Escalated with (a); the twin should take the `{{property}}` split shape, and its sentence says `collection` where the panel's says `panel`, so reuse-or-new is that card's triage call.
- (c) Remove row has no tooltip where the other three actions do — note only; unchanged behaviour, and the accessible name is present.
